<parameter=code>
# White diamond back at (21, 39) with 12 pixels.
# Dark gray at (44, 31) with 12 pixels.
# Purple diamond exists. Let me find it and click on it.

seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

# Find purple diamond
p_diamonds = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'p' and n['pixels'] >= 10]
print(f"Purple diamonds: {len(p_diamonds)}")
for p in p_diamonds:
    center = (sum(b[0] for b in p['boundary'])//len(p['boundary']), sum(b[1] for b in p['boundary'])//len(p['boundary']))
    print(f"  pixels={p['pixels']}, center~{center}, boundary={p['boundary']}")

# Find dark gray
g_objects = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'G' and n['pixels'] >= 10]
print(f"\nDark gray objects: {len(g_objects)}")
for g in g_objects:
    center = (sum(b[0] for b in g['boundary'])//len(g['boundary']), sum(b[1] for b in g['boundary'])//len(g['boundary']))
    print(f"  pixels={g['pixels']}, center~{center}, boundary={g['boundary']}")

# Click on purple diamond center
if p_diamonds:
    p = p_diamonds[0]
    center = (sum(b[0] for b in p['boundary'])//len(p['boundary']), sum(b[1] for b in p['boundary'])//len(p['boundary']))
    print(f"\nClicking on purple diamond at {center}")
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center[0], 'col': center[1]}])
    print(f"Action result: {result}")
    print(f"Level completed: {result.get('level_completed', False)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
